visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing bright purple latex gloves carefully places two ceramic bowls filled with noodles onto a square-patterned white tiled table. The bowl in focus contains thick noodles topped with fried vegetarian bits and fresh green cilantro leaves. (2) A female worker wearing a maroon short-sleeved shirt, a yellow face mask, a white hairnet cap, and purple gloves is seen in a small kitchen area. She uses long metal tongs to prepare food in a bowl while steam rises from adjacent cooking pots. (3) The camera zooms in on a bowl of noodles being mixed with dark brown sauce and green bean sprouts. Then, chopsticks lift a generous portion of the saucy noodles, showcasing their texture against a background of white and pink floral bowls. (4) Various vegetarian side dishes are presented in a rapid montage, including crispy golden-brown fried tofu skins being seasoned with white pepper, deep-fried eggplant slices with a soft interior, and vegetable rolls sliced into bite-sized pieces on a decorated plate. (5) A silver metal spoon is used to stir a dark, rich herbal soup filled with numerous pieces of brown mock meat and ginger slivers. The soup appears steaming hot in a floral-patterned bowl, placed on the same white tiled tabletop. (6) A tabby cat with white patches walks across the tiled floor of the restaurant past white plastic stools. Finally, an outdoor shot shows the shop front of '正親素食' with a metal stall, yellow banners, and a white scooter parked nearby.

(7) [Subtitle]: 還有加醋製作的榨菜. (8) [Subtitle]: 酸香刷嘴. (9) [Subtitle]: 敢吃辣一定要加手炒辣油. (10) [Subtitle]: 喜歡清爽口感就試試米粉羹. (11) [Subtitle]: 吃起來滑順不腻. (12) [Subtitle]: 可以加醋加辣更好吃. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有附素排骨. (14) [Subtitle]: 推薦加點一份炸物. (15) [Subtitle]: 炸豆包蓬鬆酥香. (16) [Subtitle]: 炸茄子外酥內嫩. (17) [Subtitle]: 豆腐捲有包蔬菜. (18) [Subtitle]: 記得喝一碗滿滿料的. (19) [Subtitle]: 濃厚當歸湯. (20) [Subtitle]: 想吃素食快去試試. (21) [Slogan]: 正親素食 高雄市三民區建武路126號. (22) [Subtitle]: 有機會遇到貓店長哦. (23) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (24) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
